verifiedOperatorPages.game: Mega Bars Fortune Wheel: Jackpot King
verifiedOperatorPages.notes: Operator page states shared Jackpot King network, any stake eligible, probability proportional to total bet, probability rises with pot value, and Royal/Regal fall before their specified paytable limits.
Operator page explicitly says the three pots are shared with other Blueprint Jackpot King games in Botemania and Canal Bingo.
The page body and RTP footer disagree on contribution percentages. Do not use contribution from this page as a hard parameter until the in-game rules/paytable fingerprint is captured.
Current page is less granular than the modern 0.38% + 0.11% disclosures and contains older reserve wording; fingerprint before use.

currentBestBaseRtpScreen.game: Mega Bars Fortune Wheel: Jackpot King
currentBestBaseRtpScreen.reason: Highest directly verified Botemania base RTP among the operator pages in this evidence pack.

scientificImplications: Shared pool membership does not prove identical jackpot hazard per EUR across titles.
Contribution percentage is funding flow and must not be substituted for player-level jackpot probability.
If equal jackpot hazard per EUR were later proven for two titles on the same pool, the higher base-RTP title would strictly dominate the lower base-RTP title before operational frictions.
Operator-page inconsistencies must fail closed until an exact in-game rules/paytable fingerprint is captured.
The published statement that probability increases with pot value invalidates a naive constant or uniform hazard assumption unless separately demonstrated.
